notes.title: New Update 2.0.4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39273025/4ccbb4654a6ad7664775df6ba8a0f11da114e3b3.jpg[/img]

- Added Cloud Saving and automatic sync with your steam account
- Added Car Market where you can put your car on sale and any player can like or buy it from you!
- Added online PVP races, you can invite any player online to race with you to target finish point!
- Added Drift Zones with global highscores!
- Added speed radar zones with global highscores!
- A lot of improvements and fixes!

Enjoy your Game! :)

notes.title: Big Update 2.0.3
notes.notes:
Change log:

- New Drift Events in Hokuta City!
- More Events in 1 session!
- High Detailed car interiors!
- Tuning Kits!
- New UI with button input controls!
- Full controller support (PS4, Xbox controller, Steering wheels are coming soon)
- Added lanes in races!
- Added 1000+ Stickers in vinyl section!
- Fixed major bugs and Optimization!
- Multiplayer optimized!

Update and have fun! We read all the reviews, and make our best for you, so if your impressions about the game has been changed in good direction, please leave a good review! Thank you and Enjoy the Game!
